The word embeddings used in the experiments were trained using Skip-gram with Negative Sampling (SGNS). The parameters used to train SGNS are summarized in Table 4. The corpus used for training is the text8 corpus (Mahoney, 2011), and the number of vocabulary words is $n = 253,854$ . Table 4: SGNS parameters.
